pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Standing with His Arms Crossed Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow the Hedgehog stands with his arms crossed in this printable coloring page, looking forward beneath lowered brows with his large air shoes set apart. His swept quills, outlined head stripe, tufted chest, and thick wrist rings define the figure against a mostly open background on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Holding a Chaos Emerald Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow the Hedgehog holds a Chaos Emerald in this printable coloring page, cupping the faceted gem between both gloved hands at chest height. His pointed quills and broad head stripe rise above the central jewel, while distinct ankle cuffs and angular air shoes finish the full-body pose.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Racing Along a Ring Trail with His Air Shoes Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow races along a curving ring trail with his air shoes in this printable coloring page, leaning forward with one fist extended toward the viewer. Large foreground rings shrink into the distance beside streaked ground, while grass-topped cliffs and rounded clouds provide an open backdrop behind his swept quills.

pages.title: Super Shadow the Hedgehog Flying Among the Seven Chaos Emeralds Coloring Page
pages.description: Super Shadow flies among seven Chaos Emeralds in this printable coloring page, hovering with clenched fists and upward-pointing quills surrounded by faceted jewels and star-shaped sparkles. Straight rays extend between the gems, leaving open spaces around the central figure and smaller sections within the emeralds and shoe panels.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Facing Sonic in a Rival Showdown Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow the Hedgehog faces Sonic in a rival showdown in this printable coloring page, with both figures holding clenched gloves in a rocky clearing. Their different quill shapes and shoes distinguish the two full-body poses, while grass tufts, distant cliffs, and clouds add detail around the space between them.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog and Sonic Racing Side By Side Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow and Sonic race side by side in this printable coloring page, striding toward the viewer along a road marked by a dashed center line. Their oversized shoes and forward fists dominate the foreground, and converging guardrails and speed lines carry the track into the distance behind them.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog and Rouge the Bat Searching for a Chaos Emerald Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow and Rouge search for a Chaos Emerald in this printable coloring page, pointing toward a faceted jewel on a carved pedestal inside stone ruins. Rouge's spread wings and heart-shaped chest panel contrast with Shadow's swept quills, while patterned pillars, cracked steps, and an arched doorway surround the pair.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Battling Knuckles in Tokyo From Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow battles Knuckles in Tokyo from Sonic the Hedgehog 3 in this printable coloring page, facing the echidna's raised spiked glove on a paved terrace. Tall buildings with gridded windows rise behind a low railing, while the fighters' chest tufts, wrist cuffs, and oversized shoes remain clearly outlined in front.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Standing Together with Sonic and Silver Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow stands together with Sonic and Silver in this printable coloring page, occupying the foreground between the other two hedgehogs with all three facing outward. Their distinct quill shapes, gloves, and shoe designs separate the figures, and the plain background keeps attention on the group's full-body arrangement.

pages.title: Movie Shadow the Hedgehog Skating Through Tokyo in Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Shadow skates through Tokyo from Sonic the Hedgehog 3 in this printable coloring page, balancing on one forward air shoe with his hands spread. Skyscrapers and roadside railings frame the street behind him, while the raised rear foot reveals sole details beneath his long, backward-swept quills.

pages.title: Movie Shadow the Hedgehog Breaking Out of His Cryogenic Capsule Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Shadow breaks out of his cryogenic capsule in this printable coloring page, stepping through its shattered opening with both fists held at his sides. Broken panels remain along the cylindrical frame, fragments cover the laboratory floor, and wall pipes and small computer consoles fill the space behind him.

pages.title: Movie Shadow the Hedgehog Confronting Sonic, Tails and Knuckles Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Shadow confronts Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles in this printable coloring page, standing opposite the three characters on a city pavement between tall buildings. Tails occupies the center of the group with his twin tails visible, while a streetlamp, elevated walkway, and large paving slabs structure the surrounding scene.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Riding a Motorcycle Along a Highway Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow rides a motorcycle along a highway in this printable coloring page, gripping the handlebars as the road curves between a cliff and distant mountains. The bike's exposed engine, mirrors, front brake disc, and wheel spokes create tightly drawn mechanical details beneath the larger shapes of Shadow's gloves and quills.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Driving His Race Car in Team Sonic Racing Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow drives his Team Sonic Racing car in this printable coloring page, leaning over the steering wheel beneath a large checkered flag beside the track. The open racer has a rear wing and sweeping front panels, with cliffs, palm trees, and a distant loop adding recognizable shapes behind the guardrail.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog as Sir Lancelot Wearing Knight Armor and Holding His Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow appears as Sir Lancelot in this printable coloring page, wearing knight armor and holding a long sword upright beneath a broad stone archway. Fleur-de-lis emblems decorate his chest and shoulders, with matching banners on the pillars and pointed castle towers visible beyond the courtyard's paving stones.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Using Chaos Control to Teleport Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow uses Chaos Control to teleport in this printable coloring page, stepping forward with a Chaos Emerald raised beside his face inside a swirling oval aura. Curved energy streaks and floating fragments surround his quills and air shoes, creating narrow shapes around the larger spaces of the central figure.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Removing His Inhibitor Rings to Release His Power Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow removes his inhibitor rings to release his power in this printable coloring page, holding a large ring near his outstretched glove as lightning surrounds him. Jagged bolts frame his full-body stance, and fractured ground and tall rock formations add angular details below and behind his oversized air shoes.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Gliding with His Doom Wings Spread Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow glides with his Doom Wings spread in this printable coloring page, hovering between small clouds beneath two towering, hooked wing shapes that curve upward. Branching wing supports create many narrow enclosed sections, while his clenched gloves, swept quills, and large air shoes form broader areas in the center.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Using Doom Surf to Cross the Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow uses Doom Surf to cross the water in this printable coloring page, crouching on an angular board with both fists extended to his sides. Sweeping patterns cover the pointed deck, while curling spray and scattered droplets trace its path across rippling water beneath a distant rocky shoreline.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Launching a Robot Into the Air with Doom Blast Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow launches a robot into the air with Doom Blast in this printable coloring page, raising one fist beneath a star-shaped impact burst and curved motion lines. The round robot tilts backward with its claw hands spread, while low cliffs, bushes, grass, and stones frame Shadow's planted stance.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Grinding Along a Rail Above Rail Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow grinds along a rail above Rail Canyon in this printable coloring page, balancing with bent knees and lowered fists over a steep rocky drop. The narrow rail curves away on cross-braced supports, and layered canyon walls provide smaller fractured shapes behind his large shoes and pointed quills.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Escaping an Armored Train in Rail Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow escapes an armored train in Rail Canyon in this printable coloring page, running toward the viewer along tracks curving high between steep rock walls. The riveted locomotive follows behind with smoke above its roof, while repeated sleepers, rail fastenings, and cracked cliff faces fill the surrounding coloring sheet.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Jumping Between Ruined Castle Towers in Kingdom Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow jumps between ruined castle towers in Kingdom Valley in this printable coloring page, stretching one shoe forward across the gap with both fists extended. Cracked circular parapets frame the leap, while distant bridges, broken towers, and a winding river descend through the rocky valley below.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Confronting Mephiles in the Ruins of Dusty Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow confronts Mephiles in the ruins of Dusty Desert in this printable coloring page, standing opposite the figure's jagged crystalline quills and pointed clawed hands. Broken columns rise above the pair, and scattered stones and cracked walls create smaller angular shapes around Shadow's smoother gloves, legs, and air shoes.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Confronting Dr. Eggman in His Eggmobile Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow confronts Dr. Eggman in his hovering Eggmobile in this printable coloring page, looking toward the open cockpit with his gloved fists at his sides. Round vents and a broad front panel define the floating craft, while tiled flooring, distant cliffs, and small domed towers form the background.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Wearing a Santa Hat and Decorating a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow wears a Santa hat while decorating a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, holding a round ornament beside branches draped with bead garlands. A star crowns the potted tree, and the hat's fluffy brim and pom-pom add rounded shapes above Shadow's pointed quills and large air shoes.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog in His Vampire Shadow Costume Beside a Halloween Jack-o'-lantern Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow wears his Vampire Shadow costume beside a Halloween jack-o'-lantern in this printable coloring page, with a high collar, buttoned vest, and long scalloped cape. A neck cloth and round cape clasps add small costume details above the pumpkin's triangular eyes and broad, pointed-tooth grin.
